chapters.title: Before the first chair

chapters.description: Understand resort economics, ski pass networks, dated industry statistics, and the pressures shaping the experience of a ski day.

chapters.title: Keep tomorrow in the plan

chapters.description: Prepare for ski days with general health guidance on fatigue, food, cold, altitude, head injuries, and when to seek qualified medical help.

chapters.title: Find your kind of mountain
chapters.seo: Where to Ski: Choose a Mountain That Fits Your Trip
chapters.description: Choose where to ski using terrain fit, regional trip questions, instruction, travel effort, group needs, and realistic mountain scorecards.

chapters.description: Compare ski passes and trip costs with clear examples covering tickets, lessons, equipment, transport, lodging, and booking flexibility.

chapters.description: Learn slope responsibility, group planning, resort boundaries, and where to find qualified avalanche education and current safety resources.

chapters.title: A sport worth passing on

chapters.description: Think about skiing’s future through local hills, inclusion, mountain communities, snow variability, technology, and habits that welcome new skiers.

chapters.seo: Skiing Glossary: Terrain, Snow, Gear & Technique Terms
chapters.description: A plain-language skiing glossary covering mountain terrain, snow conditions, equipment, technique, and access terms, with a searchable term filter.

chapters.description: Find skiing history, industry data, instructor education, adaptive sports, weather, health, and avalanche resources with clear explanations of their uses.
